summary.one_liner: AirOps is a marketing services and software platform that helps brands plan and execute an AI discovery strategy, combining strategy consulting with agents for researching, publishing, and refreshing content.
keywords: brand market share in ai search
use_cases: Measuring brand market share in AI-generated recommendations
Planning a channel mix for AI discovery
Producing and refreshing SEO/AEO content with agents
Tracking results against pipeline and revenue
Improving brand presence in ChatGPT and Google AI answers
summary.what_it_does: The page presents AirOps as a partner that sets and executes an AI discovery strategy for a brand, starting with assessing market share and competitor position across buyers. It describes identifying high-impact channels and building a strategy to fill the marketing funnel. The AirOps platform is described as combining agents, data, brand governance, and expertise to research, publish, and refresh content that learns over time. Results are said to be tracked and tied to pipeline and revenue, with a hands-on team involved throughout. The page does not describe specific product screens or pricing.
notable: Measures market share with the right buyers rather than just a visibility score
Agent-based system for continuous research, publishing, and content refresh
Hands-on team engagement from strategy through execution
Ties marketing activity to pipeline and revenue
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; engagement appears to be a custom service
Page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete product details or features
The listing's 'task-specific AI apps' description (NLP, SQL tools) is not reflected in this page's text
